content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham offers undergraduate, postgraduate, integrated degree, doctoral and certificate programmes, with Law among its areas of study. Its website lists locations that include Coimbatore, Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai and Kochi. These vacancies are in its Amrita International School of Law at the Coimbatore Campus.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Associate Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The notice sets these requirements for the post: Qualification: Master in Law and PhD. Guidelines: The required qualifications shall be as per UGC/BCI guidelines. Academic record: A good academic record, with a minimum score as per the stipulated standards of the Bar Council of India (BCI). Research score: A required minimum research score of 75. Publications: At least 7 publications in SCOPUS / WoS / Peer Reviewed / UGC Listed Journals, etc. Industry experience: Any industry experience shall be directly related to Law. The school looks for a strong passion for teaching, a commitment to high-quality course content, and a readiness to take on responsibility and challenging opportunities. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Associate Professor (Law)
content_sections.text: Deliver lectures, tutorials and seminars on assigned legal subjects. Develop, update and implement course content and syllabi to reflect current legal trends and standards. Conduct scholarly research in various areas of law and contribute to academic publications. Provide mentorship and academic counselling, guiding students through their academic and career development. Supervise student projects, internships and moot court activities. Design and conduct student assessments, with constructive feedback on progress and performance. Participate in departmental meetings and academic committees, and contribute to institutional policies and programmes.

content_sections.text: Open the Associate Professor (Law) @ Coimbatore job page . Apply through the APPLY NOW option on that page. For details about the post, write to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What qualification is needed for this post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a Master in Law and PhD, with the required qualifications as per UGC/BCI guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. What research score is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum research score of 75, in addition to a good academic record that meets the Bar Council of India's stipulated standards.

faq.question: Q3. How many publications must a candidate have?
faq.answer: At least 7 publications are required. They may be in SCOPUS, WoS, peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, among others.

faq.question: Q4. Does industry experience count?
faq.answer: The notice says that industry experience shall be directly related to Law.

faq.question: Q5. Does the job include research as well as teaching?
faq.answer: Yes. Along with lectures, tutorials and seminars, the post involves scholarly research in various areas of law and contributing to academic publications.

faq.question: Q6. Will the Associate Professor work with students outside the classroom?
faq.answer: Yes. The duties include mentoring and academic counselling, and supervising student projects, internships and moot court activities.

faq.question: Q7. Whom can I contact for more details?
faq.answer: The notice gives [email protected] as the contact for details.
